evidence.observation: "A subset miss requires broader investigation or deferral before asserting novelty." Broader investigation can still leave the host with a subset, so this rule permits a novelty assertion after another partial miss.

concerns.recommendation: State what evidence permits a novelty assertion when prompt scope was partial. Require deferral while coverage remains insufficient, and test repeated partial misses.
concerns.title: Partial searches lack a safe stopping rule

evidence.observation: The contract promises "registered constraint signatures," while GC1 specifies tests for only "guarded and anchored signatures." A projection could omit another registered constraint family and satisfy the stated tests.

concerns.recommendation: Require a fixture or generated check for every registered family, including its referenced IDs and ordered roles, with an explicit failure when a family cannot be represented.
concerns.title: Constraint fidelity is not demonstrated for every registered family

evidence.observation: GC1 says "Compare compact versus ordinary review bytes on the same populated schema fixture," and the controls say "Measure actual UTF-8 bytes and confine comparisons to the measured fixture." Neither sets a passing result; a larger projection would meet both instructions.

concerns.recommendation: Set a byte-size acceptance criterion for the populated fixture and record both measured values against it.
concerns.title: The compactness requirement has no pass criterion

evidence.observation: The plan calls for "stable identifiers" and says to "Verify complete identifiers on fixtures," but presence of IDs does not test whether equivalent composed views retain the same IDs and references.

concerns.recommendation: Compare projected IDs and references across equivalent source representations, including evidence-only edits and reordered fields whose order is not meaningful; include an include-backed fixture.
concerns.title: Identifier presence does not establish stability

response.summary: The plan needs falsifiable checks for compactness, schema fidelity, identifier stability, and novelty decisions after partial searches.
